lines.zh: 我在深海里挪动整座身体。
lines.en: I shift my whole bulk through the deep.

lines.zh: 八条触手一起推水前进。
lines.en: Eight arms push the water and I advance.

lines.zh: 我从海沟的暗处滑出去。
lines.en: I slide out of the trench's dark.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底走，沙被卷起。
lines.en: I skim the seabed and raise the sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕着一根石柱转。
lines.en: I wind slowly around a stone pillar.
I am longer than a sunken ship.

lines.zh: 我朝着有光的地方浮一点。
lines.en: I rise a little toward the light.
I push myself past the coral.

lines.zh: 我的触手在身后拖得很远。
lines.en: My arms trail far behind me.
I leave a line of murk behind.
I move sideways across the whole floor.

lines.zh: 我游过去时水压都变了。
lines.en: The pressure itself shifts as I pass.
I crawl up along the cliff wall.

lines.zh: 我从深海往外探出一截。
lines.en: I reach one part of myself out of the deep.
No hurry; the sea is wide.

lines.zh: 我的触手依次拍在沙上。
lines.en: My arms strike the sand one after another.

lines.zh: 我转了个方向，水跟着旋。
lines.en: I turn, and the water spins with me.
I move upward through the black.

lines.zh: 我伏在海床上，像一座丘。
lines.en: I rest on the seabed like a hill.
My arms unfurl slowly.
I wait for a hull's shadow.
My eyes shine in the dark.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，水自己绕开。
lines.en: I barely move; the water bends around me.
I keep watch over this trench.
My breathing raises bubbles.
I hang in the midwater, heavy.
The tips of my arms sway lightly.
I listen to a whale far off.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把一条触手蜷起。
lines.en: I slowly curl one arm.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的季节。
lines.en: I wait for a season that will not come.

lines.zh: 我身上挂着很旧的海草。
lines.en: Old kelp hangs from me.

lines.zh: 我从水里抬起一只眼睛。
lines.en: I raise one eye out of the water.
You are so small, and I see you clearly.
My arms turn toward your boat.

lines.zh: 水里的光都落在我背上。
lines.en: All the water's light rests on my back.
I rise bit by bit.
You did not hear me surface.
I stare at the line of the surface.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你整个人大。
lines.en: My eye is bigger than all of you.
I tuck my arms beneath me.
All my arms draw in.
My movement halts a beat.

lines.zh: 水里散开一片更深的黑。
lines.en: A deeper black spreads in the water.
I do not cry out; I sink.
My arms twitch.
I slowly draw myself in.
The pain clouds the water.
I fix on you without moving.

lines.zh: 墨从我腕间涌出，盖住伤口。
lines.en: Ink pours from my arms and covers the wound.
That is not one mouthful for me.
I come a little nearer the hull.

lines.zh: 我绕着你投下的东西转。
lines.en: I circle what you dropped.
I swallow it with the water.
I touch it with one arm.
I prefer things that move.
I drag it into the deep.
I sniff and lose interest.
I wait for something bigger.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的触手，被弹开。
lines.en: You hit my arm and are thrown back.
My body is a wall of flesh.

lines.zh: 船身撞在我背上，晃得厉害。
lines.en: The hull hits my back and rocks hard.
I shift aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 水被我们挤出一声闷响。
lines.en: Our contact squeezes out a dull sound.
My arm catches your oar.
I am nudged one block.
Ripples reach the shore in rings.
The place you touched is hard.
I have no reaction to that at all.

lines.zh: 两条巨大的影子在深处相遇。
lines.en: Two vast shadows meet in the deep.

lines.zh: 我们的触手缠了一会儿。
lines.en: Our arms tangle for a while.
We sink to the seabed together.
Its eye meets mine.
We push the water together.
Our bodies lie very close.
Neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 我们的触手在水里交错。
lines.en: Our arms cross in the water.

lines.zh: 我们一起浮向同一片光。
lines.en: We rise toward the same light.

lines.zh: 我用触手卷起沉船的桅杆。
lines.en: I curl an arm around a sunken mast.
I drag it to the trench edge.

lines.zh: 我抓起一块石头又扔了。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and toss it.
It looks tiny in my arms.
I stuff it into a reef crack.
I carry it deeper.
I wrap it twice to hold it.

lines.zh: 触手上的吸盘，把船锚粘住了。
lines.en: The suckers on my arm fasten onto a ship's anchor.
I coil around it and sink.
I let go and it floats up.
I turn my entire bulk.
The surface begins to heave.

lines.zh: 我找到你了，很小的东西。
lines.en: I have found you, little thing.
I rise toward your direction.
My arms spread one by one.

lines.zh: 水压变了，你也能感觉到。
lines.en: The pressure shifts and you can feel it.

lines.zh: 我在深处锁定了一个点。
lines.en: I have fixed a point in the deep.
I begin to move up.
There is nowhere for you to run.
My eyes stay on the surface.
I follow the shadow under the hull.
Wherever you row, I am beneath.
I touch the hull's underside.
I have not surfaced once.
You hear one dull knock.
The water keeps heaving.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的船走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle your boat once.

lines.zh: 我探出一条触手又收回。
lines.en: I reach one arm out and withdraw it.
I draw your boat deeper.
An arm coils around your leg.

lines.zh: 我猛地一扯，你被拖进水里。
lines.en: I yank and drag you into the water.
My arm cracks across the planks.
I lift you and slam you down.
Water floods your mouth.
I tighten and you cannot move.
I hold until you stop moving.
An arm tip jabs your back.
You are flung into the reef.
I press you down slowly.

lines.zh: 深海里出现了一片更大的黑。
lines.en: A larger darkness appears in the deep.
The seabed sand lifts.
A wide patch of foam rises.
I wake in this trench.

lines.zh: 一个影子在海图上移动。
lines.en: A shadow moves across the chart.
The fish all flee at once.
I have not come to this layer in a long time.

lines.zh: 我在两条洋流之间出现。
lines.en: I appear between two currents.
You hear something from the seabed.
A wall has appeared under the surface.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的腕尖烫了。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and my arm tips scorch.

lines.zh: 我被甩上礁石，重重砸下。
lines.en: I am thrown onto the reef and crash down.

lines.zh: 我在自己的海里喘不上气。
lines.en: I cannot breathe in my own sea.

lines.zh: 爆风在水下炸开，我翻了一圈。
lines.en: The blast bursts underwater and I roll over.

lines.zh: 一支弩箭钉进我的皮里。
lines.en: A bolt buries in my hide.

lines.zh: 那股力量勒紧了我的腕子。
lines.en: That force binds my arms tight.
Hunger leaves me lying on the seabed.

lines.zh: 雷劈到水面，我整片身子一麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface and numbs me all over.

lines.zh: 下面的海也没有了，我往下坠。
lines.en: Even the sea below is gone; I drop.
